rejected_rule.statement: A party cannot be added as a 'necessary party' under Section 18(1) of the Civil Procedure Code if the plaintiff's claim against the defendants and the defendant's claim against the proposed additional party can be pursued and determined separately.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: The plaintiff's claim against the defendants and any claim the defendants may have against Golden Key are not intertwined or inextricably linked in a manner that they must all be determined in the present action.
rejected_rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 18 (1) of the Civil Procedure Code
